newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends quiet session higher.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends quiet session higher.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended a quiet session higher on Monday, lifted by commercial buying and a lack of fund sales, traders said.
"We had what appeared to be commercial buying," one pit source said. "On the other side of that, the selling we had was not very aggressive and there was no fund action."
Funds had been aggressive sellers in recent weeks, contributing to the steep decline. The September contract has shed $1.00 per cwt since June 25.
Floor sources said LIT and Dean Witter were both light buyers of the September and November.
Rice ended 18 to two cents per cwt higher with September up nine at $9.43.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 450 lots, compared with Friday's actual volume of 528 lots.
